summary: Tested Knowledge Base document download feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass covering file upload+original-byte download (SHA-verified), text-note fallback (.txt with X-KB-Original:0), URL doc download, non-admin download allowed + upload forbidden (403), unauthenticated 401 / unknown-id 404, and delete flow removing subsequent download (404). Frontend (Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): admin login → /knowledge-base loaded, uploaded a .txt via hidden input, new row appeared with kb-doc-download-<id> button; expect_download captured browser download with suggested filename equal to original filename and bytes byte-identical to source (800/800). Text note flow saved via kb-add-text-btn/kb-text-save then download produced <title>.txt with matching body AND toast 'Original file not stored — downloaded the indexed text instead...' appeared. Size labels (KB/MB) rendered. Legacy PDF row shows amber 'text only' hint. Cleanup succeeded via delete buttons. Ask Nyla widget renders; no console errors on KB page (only pre-login 401s from /auth/me — expected).
critical_code_review_comments: download_document uses only 'attachment; filename*=UTF-8''<url-encoded>' — no ASCII 'filename=' fallback. Modern browsers all support filename*=, but very old clients may not; low priority.
delete_document logs a warning on object-storage delete failure but still returns success — acceptable, but the storage object could linger orphaned.

services/object_storage.py MIME_TYPES map only covers a handful of formats; docx/pptx/xlsx uploads without a client-provided content_type fall back to application/octet-stream. In practice UploadFile.content_type is populated by browsers, so it works; consider extending the map for robustness.

Non-admin RBAC for KB is auth-only (any authenticated tenant user can list & download all KB docs). Matches request intent but worth confirming against the 'knowledge_base' module access-control used elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: All QA docs prefixed with TEST_ and deleted at end of each backend test and UI run. No residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response returns 'session_token' and sets httpOnly cookie; Bearer header works. Post-login redirect is /home. Tenant defaults to nyla-air-water via DEFAULT_TENANT_ID. Download endpoint uses RFC 5987 'filename*=UTF-8''...' only; frontend handleDownload regex-matches it. Object storage init requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (already configured).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature implemented correctly; all acceptance criteria met.
